project_type: Harbor Terminal-Bench debugging task - priority-based task scheduler
build_system: Docker with python:3.11-slim base, uv for pytest
test_framework: pytest via uv run, 10 tests in 3 tiers
test_command: docker run --rm scheduler-test bash -c 'cd /app && python3 -m runtime.run_scheduler && uv run --with pytest pytest /tests/test_scheduler.py -v'
verification_instructions: Build Docker image, run scheduler, then run pytest. 4 easy tests should pass with buggy code, 3 medium tests need 1-2 fixes, 3 hard tests need 3-4 fixes.
setup_instructions: No setup needed - this is a greenfield task creation
environment_constraints: Greenfield creation of a debugging challenge. The task runs inside Docker.
contribution_requirements: Harbor Terminal-Bench format: environment/, instruction.md, task.toml, tests/, solution/
key_patterns: 4 bugs: config space in split (Bug A), wrong config section (Bug B), accumulation instead of assignment (Bug C), missing sort key field (Bug D). Anti-Sonnet measures: 400+ lines, red herrings, cross-file hints, no TODO/FIXME comments.
directory_structure: environment/ (Dockerfile + runtime code), tests/ (test.sh + pytest), solution/ (solve.sh + repair script), instruction.md, task.toml
